Color Audio browse by type volume/amplification amplification preamp / clean boost browse by enclosure pedal Color Audio Cassette Preamp Published on July 18, 2025 Color Audio boost / preamp pedal gutshot gutshot Information The Color Audio Cassette Preamp is a boutique preamp pedal inspired by the channel strip of a vintage Japanese cassette multitrack recorder. It captures the distinct tonal characteristics and saturation of analog cassette circuits, translating them into a compact and versatile pedal format suitable for guitar, bass, or studio use. Originally based on the preamp section of a Japanese cassette MTR (multitrack recorder), the Cassette Preamp reproduces its warm, compressed tone and subtle harmonic distortion, while adding modern refinements for flexibility and reliability. It can serve as a preamp for DI recording, a tone-shaping tool in front of an amplifier, or a characterful front-end for any instrument or line-level source. The sound ranges from lightly compressed cleans to rich, fuzzy saturation with strong harmonic presence. Internally, the circuit uses NJM2068 and M5218 operational amplifiers to faithfully recreate the response of the original tape channel strip, enhanced through contemporary low-noise components for improved stability and durability. The pedal features Neutrik input/output jacks, Alpha potentiometers, and a robust aluminum chassis. Soft-touch relay switching ensures true bypass operation, with automatic bypass in case of power loss. The control layout includes Gain and Level for drive and output adjustment, Treble and Bass EQ with ±10 dB range for tone shaping, and additional LPF and HPF switches for filtering and tonal contouring. These allow the Cassette Preamp to function as both a transparent preamp or a coloration tool with a distinctive vintage compression feel. Controls Gain: Adjusts input drive and preamp saturation. Level: Controls output volume. Treble: ±10 dB high-frequency EQ adjustment. Bass: ±10 dB low-frequency EQ adjustment. LPF Switch: Engages a variable low-pass filter (off at maximum). HPF Switch: Selects high-pass filter settings for tighter low-end response or enhanced drive. Technical Specifications Bypass: Relay-switched true bypass with auto-bypass on power loss.
